privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: MyGrowth ("the App") is made by Sagomak and is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we handle your data.

short.title: The Short Version
short.body: We don't collect your habit data. Everything you track stays on your device.

stored.title: What Data Is Stored
stored.intro: The App stores the following data locally on your iPhone:
items: Daily log entries (date, value, optional notes)
App preferences (theme, onboarding status, consent records)
stored.footer: This data is stored using iOS on-device storage (UserDefaults). It never leaves your device.

notCollect.title: What We Don't Collect
items: No personal information (name, email, phone, location)
No usage analytics or crash reports
No habits, logs or notes are ever transmitted to any server

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: The App contains no analytics tools, ad networks or cloud services. Its only third-party SDK is RevenueCat, used to check in-app purchases (see Purchases below).

rights.title: Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
rights.access: Access your data: visible directly in the app at any time
rights.export: Export your data: via Settings, Data Management, Export (JSON or CSV)
rights.delete: Delete your data: via Settings, Data Management, Clear All Data
rights.rectify: Rectify your data: edit any entry by tapping it in the app
rights.footer: Since all data is stored exclusively on your device, exercising these rights requires no request to us, you have full control.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: Your data persists on your device until you delete it within the app or uninstall the app. Uninstalling permanently removes all data.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: The App does not knowingly collect data from children under 16. Since no personal information is collected from any user, the App is compliant with COPPA and GDPR age requirements.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: If we update this policy, we will post the revised version on this page with an updated date.

purchases.title: Purchases
body: MyGrowth Pro is sold through Apple's App Store. Apple processes every payment; we never see your name, Apple ID or payment details.

To know which purchases are active, the App uses RevenueCat, Inc. (revenuecat.com), a subscription service that processes this data on our behalf. When the App starts, and when you buy or restore a purchase, RevenueCat receives a random anonymous ID created by the App, your purchase and subscription history from Apple's receipt, and basic technical details: device type, operating system, locale and currency.

RevenueCat receives none of your habits, logs or notes, and no name, email or account details. This data is not used for tracking or advertising. See RevenueCat's privacy policy at revenuecat.com/privacy and Apple's at apple.com/legal/privacy.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: Welcome to MyGrowth ("the App"). By downloading or using the App, you agree to these terms.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using MyGrowth, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the App.

description.title: Description of Service
description.body: MyGrowth is a personal habit-tracking application for iOS. It allows you to log daily activities, visualize your progress through heatmap grids and charts, and manage your personal data, all stored locally on your device.

responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
items: You are responsible for all data you enter into the App
You are responsible for maintaining backups of your data using the export feature
You must not use the App for any unlawful purpose
You must not attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or tamper with the App

dataPrivacy.title: Data and Privacy
dataPrivacy.item1: All data is stored locally on your device
dataPrivacy.item2: We do not collect, transmit, or have access to your habits, logs or notes
dataPrivacy.item3: For full details, see our <link>Privacy Policy</link>

ip.title: Intellectual Property
ip.body: MyGrowth, including its design, code, and visual assets, is the intellectual property of its developer, Sagomak. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the App for personal, non-commercial purposes.

iap.title: In-App Purchases
iap.body: The App may offer optional premium features via in-app purchases. All purchases are processed by Apple through the App Store and are subject to Apple's terms and conditions. Refunds are handled by Apple per their refund policy. The App checks your purchase status through RevenueCat, as described in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

warranties.title: Disclaimer of Warranties
warranties.body: The App is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the App will be error-free, uninterrupted, or free of harmful components.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, the developer shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the App, including but not limited to data loss.

dataLoss.title: Data Loss
dataLoss.body: Since all data is stored locally on your device, we are not responsible for data loss due to device failure, iOS updates, app deletion, or any other cause. We recommend regularly exporting your data using the built-in export feature.

modifications.title: Modifications
modifications.body: We reserve the right to update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms. The latest version will always be available at this page.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: We may terminate or suspend your access to the App at any time, without notice, for conduct that we believe violates these Terms or is harmful to other users or the App.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Denmark, without regard to conflict of law principles.

languageNote: This is a translation. In case of differences, the English version prevails.
